profile.title: Profile
profile.content: Hands-on and hardworking engineering student with a strong interest in problem-solving and practical work. Experienced in teamwork, leadership, and customer-facing environments through Scouting and engineering projects. Comfortable in fast-paced settings and proactive in taking responsibility.

education.title: A-Levels & BTECs
achievements: Level 3 National Diploma in Engineering (Double BTEC)

education.title: GCSEs
achievements: GCSEs including English Language (7), Maths (6), Triple Science and others.
School Certificate in Philosophy (Northeastern University London & Cranleigh School) (7)

experience.title: Workshop Mechanic - Work Placement
experience.description: Short work placement in a specialist kit car workshop, supporting day-to-day mechanical tasks and vehicle preparation while learning from experienced engineers in a professional environment and relevant industry.
achievements: Assisted in the build and assembly of specialist kit cars, gaining hands-on mechanical engineering experience.
Carried out maintenance, inspections, and preparation of a bike-engine vehicle for track use.
Developed problem-solving, teamwork, and adaptability in a fast-paced workshop environment.

experience.title: Young Leader - Volunteer Work
experience.description: Long-term volunteering role supporting the delivery of weekly Scouting sessions, working with leaders to run activities, manage groups of children, and ensure a safe, organised environment.
achievements: Delivered weekly sessions for Cubs (aged 8–10), including activities, games, and workshops.
Took responsibility for managing resources, planning evenings and ensuring safety which helped to build confidence and leadership in a live environment.
Presented at AGMs, speaking to large audiences including parents and leaders, helping to improve my public speaking in a formal setting as well as overcome my stutter.

awards.title: Awards and Achievements
items: Head Student at Stone Lodge School

skills.title: Engineering & Technical
items: Built an off-road buggy, two kit cars, contributed to a twin-engine Fiat 500 and restored a 1999 Saab 9-3.
Confident with mechanical fitting tasks such as component installation and alignment, basic welding, and safe use of workshop tools.
Experience with CAD and practical problem-solving on real projects.

skills.title: Leadership, Teamwork & Responsibility
items: Scouting Young Leader, delivering and assisting with weekly sessions for Cubs as previously mentioned.
Public speaking at AGMs, events, assemblies, and open evenings.
Head Student at Stone Lodge Sixth Form, representing students and supporting staff across the school.

skills.title: Enterprise & Initiative
items: Designed, 3D printed, and sold custom products for school sports teams.
Experience reselling items online (eBay, Facebook Marketplace, Vinted), managing listings, communication, and logistics.

skills.title: Miscellaneous.
items: First Aid trained through my Young Leader work.
Attended two international Scout camps, demonstrating independence and adaptability.
